product_concept: A robust-but-simple US 1099 tax & get-paid toolkit for a specific freelancer sub-niche (e.g. content creators or rideshare/independent contractors): a spreadsheet that gets the SE-tax + quarterly-estimate math right, plus an invoice template and a short setup guide.

verdict.reason: 0 qualified of 1 imported; 45% of weight is unknown (views/audience-problem data largely missing). Not enough to conclude.
contradictory_evidence: Free 1099 templates are abundant — risk of a 'free-information' problem for the generic version.
Etsy SEO is owned by high-volume generalist shops — the marketing problem may exceed the product problem.
A subset of freelancers offload this entirely to an accountant and won't buy a tool.
No imported creator qualified on audience+problem+content.
